generationOutcome.question: List each OpenMRS-native concept with no CIEL mapping, its name, and its total observation count, highest count first.
generationOutcome.sql:
SELECT 
  t1.concept_name, 
  SUM(t1.observation_count) AS total_observation_count
FROM analytics.hiv_concept_mapping_v1 AS t1
WHERE t1.ciel_code IS NULL
GROUP BY 
  t1.concept_name
ORDER BY 
  total_observation_count DESC

candidate.sql:
SELECT 
  t1.concept_name, 
  SUM(t2.observation_count) AS total_observation_count
FROM analytics.hiv_concept_mapping_v1 AS t1
JOIN analytics.hiv_observation_fact_v1 AS t2 
  ON t1.concept_name = t2.concept_name
WHERE t1.ciel_code IS NULL
GROUP BY 
  t1.concept_name
ORDER BY 
  total_observation_count DESC
